Maria L.: Heads up — saw a ~$18k GPU spend in us-central1 this month that's labeled "unattributed" in the bill. Not matching any known teams. Anyone tracking a migration or test cluster there?
AJ: Which export are you looking at? invoice_id or billing export table?
Maria L.: billing.gcp_cost_export.gcp_billing_export_v1_012345 — I filtered by sku_description: NVIDIA A100 and labels = NULL. Query below.
AJ: paste query
AJ: ```sql
SELECT project_id, sku_description, sum(cost) as cost
FROM `billing.gcp_cost_export.gcp_billing_export_v1_012345`
WHERE sku_description LIKE '%NVIDIA A100%'
AND sku_service == 'Compute Engine'
AND (labels IS NULL OR labels = '{}')
GROUP BY project_id, sku_description
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
Samir: I think those are from a short-lived capacity test we did for Dedicated in us-central — the automation created instances under the internal billing project `redwood-infra-loadtest` but forgot to set `redwood:owner` labels. The commitments were purchased under a different billing account (corp-reserved) so the cost attribution got split.
Kavi: Checked `gcloud compute reservations list --filter='region:us-central1'` — I see an orphaned reservation `reserve-ci-2029` tied to project `redwood-infra-loadtest`.
Tara: Oof. That explains mismatch between commitment utilization and chargeback. Proposal: retroactively map those untagged resource usage to product teams via a ledger mapping and run a backfill job to attribute costs for Mar-Apr.
Maria L.: Agree. Can we run a BigQuery backfill that joins instance IDs to reservation IDs and then inject label mapping? We need minimal disruption and an audit trail.
AJ: We can run a backfill adding `redwood:owner` using a mapping table. Sample update job:
```sql
-- create mapping table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS billing.relabel_map (instance_id STRING, owner STRING);
-- insert map rows manually from infra logs
-- run attribution
SELECT
  t.*,
  COALESCE(m.owner, 'unattributed') as owner
FROM `billing.gcp_cost_export.gcp_billing_export_v1_012345` t
LEFT JOIN billing.relabel_map m
ON t.resource_name = m.instance_id;
```
InfraBot: :info: Reservation `reserve-ci-2029` created by Samir on 2029-03-12 04:22 UTC — no labels found.
Samir: That's my test run, sorry — should have added labels. I'll own the re-label + automation fix. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Kavi: I'll open a ticket to move the reservation under `corp-reserved` so future billing flows cleanly and add a CI check to enforce labels on creation.
Tara: Also recommend showing the interim chargeback in the Console so teams see the corrections. I can draft the message to PS and finance.
Maria L.: Perfect. Action items: Samir — run relabel backfill; Kavi — update reservations + CI check; Tara — finance comms; AJ — run the attribution query and share result. Thanks :thumbsup:
